source: lab (real capture, Orbbec Femto Mega RGB)

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of the right wall region < 0.12 px in every frame; scene/tracks/camera_shift.csv)

intrinsics_from_benchmark_convention.note: focal = 0.5959 x 1280; principal point assumed at image centre

camera.view: elevated, looking down and forward along a carpeted room floor; floor recedes upward in the image; right wall/floor junction runs diagonally from about (700,90) to (1280,520); left wall at x < 130

white_board.description: flat white rectangular board (white plastic board/tray) with two small clear clips on its far edge; lies flat on the floor and slides away from the camera, from the lower right toward the upper centre-left
white_board.distinguish: the only large white object; the white tape strips on the floor are thin lines
white_board.visible_frames: 0-48 (frames 0-18 its near edge runs off the bottom of the image, so the near part is cut off)
white_board.track: tracks/white_board.csv (mask centroid = visible centre, bbox, minAreaRect long/short side and angle, area, cut flag); tracks/white_board_corners.csv (4 corners + edge lengths)
white_board.reference_point: centroid of the board mask (visible centre). Biased toward the far edge in frames 0-18 while the board is cut by the image bottom
white_board.apparent_size: minAreaRect long side 321 px (f0, cut) -> 299 (f24) -> 260 (f30) -> 230 (f36) -> 204 (f48); near edge 301 px (f0-20) -> 276 (f24) -> 222 (f36) -> 179 (f48); far edge 283 (f0) -> 236 (f24) -> 194 (f36) -> 162 (f48). It shrinks because it moves away from the camera

basketball.description: orange basketball in the background behind (left of) the blue bin, next to the wooden cabinet
basketball.distinguish: the only orange ball; the wooden cabinet behind it has a similar colour (hue 18-21 vs ball 10-15)
basketball.visible_frames: 0-48, always partly hidden by the blue bin (right side); in frames 0-17 only a small part shows
basketball.motion_summary: nearly still in frames 0-16, moves out to the left of the bin in frames 17-22 and down/toward the camera in frames 22-24, drifts back right behind the bin in frames 25-35, then comes out left and down again in frames 36-48 (still moving at the end)
basketball.track: tracks/basketball.csv (visible-mask centroid, bbox, estimated diameter = vertical extent, estimated centre = left edge + d/2, vertical middle); low reliability, about +-4 px

static_objects: static_objects.json (frame 48: centroid, bbox, minAreaRect length/width/angle in px). Verified still in all frames: milk_carton, plush_bear, blue_tote_bag, blue_bin, tennis_ball_near_tripod, wall_outlet_plate (mean abs diff vs frame 0 <= 6.4 grey levels). yellow_speck_floor and the two white tape strips are static floor features that the board covers or crosses

other_static_scene_items.tripod: black camera tripod at the left, legs spanning about x 100-300, y 0-270
other_static_scene_items.wooden_cabinet: light-brown cabinet at the top left, x 95-300, y 0-130
other_static_scene_items.seated_person: person seated at a desk at the top centre, legs/shoes visible about x 420-520, y 0-160 (small movements only)
other_static_scene_items.standing_person: person standing at the top centre-right, dark trousers, about x 600-665, y 0-185
other_static_scene_items.cables: orange extension cables and black cables along the right wall/floor junction and around the tripod

events.board_motion_start: frame 16 (t=0.667 s): first 1 px shift; frame 17 (t=0.708 s): clearly moving (11.7 px step). It is pushed in from below the frame; no pusher is visible
events.board_fastest_image_motion: frames 19-22 (25-26 px/frame of centroid, partly from the cut-off part coming into view), then about 15-20 px/frame (f23-35), 12-15 px/frame (f37-48)
events.board_irregular_step: frame 35->36 step = 31 px vs about 15 px in neighbouring frames: probably a dropped or duplicated capture frame (or a timing jitter); treat with care
events.board_end: still sliding at frame 48 (11 px/frame); does not stop in the clip
events.basketball_motion: starts moving about frame 17 (t=0.71 s); still moving at frame 48

files.tracks/white_board_corners.csv: per-frame board corners (far-left, far-right, near-right, near-left) and edge lengths
files.scripts/: all measurement scripts (run from scene_ws: track.py, then corners_post.py, static.py, checks.py)
